items.title: Most-detailed-ever view of the sun's surface revealed in new images from the world's largest solar telescope
items.summary: For the first time, scientists have directly observed a 150-year-old predicted phenomenon on the sun's surface that could explain why the sun's atmosphere is far hotter than its surface.
items.zh: 世界上最大的太阳望远镜的新图像揭示了有史以来最详细的太阳表面视图

items.title: Here’s what the first mRNA flu vaccine could mean for flu season
items.summary: Compared with standard flu shots, Moderna’s mFlusiva generates stronger, longer-lasting immunity and is more effective at preventing infection, data show.
items.zh: 这是第一个 mRNA 流感疫苗对流感季节的意义

items.title: Sugar may have been a key ingredient in human evolution
items.summary: A sweet tooth for sugars from fruits and honey may have helped fuel brain growth in our primate cousins and early human ancestors, a new study suggests.
items.zh: 糖可能是人类进化的关键成分

items.title: FDA approves first mRNA vaccine for seasonal flu
items.summary: The Food and Drug Administration's approval of an mRNA vaccine for flu comes after the agency initially refused to review the approval request for the shot.

items.summary: New images from South Korea's Danuri lunar orbiter reveal where a runaway SpaceX rocket part slammed into the moon on Wednesday.

items.title: How Does Touch Lead To Pain Or Pleasure?

items.zh: 触摸如何带来痛苦或愉悦？

items.summary: Within minutes of impact, debris began heating Earth’s atmosphere. Fine dust trapped that heat, potentially killing the dinosaurs quickly.

items.title: Major study challenges long-held fears about acetaminophen and ibuprofen use in babies
items.summary: A landmark study of nearly 4,000 babies found that acetaminophen and ibuprofen were equally safe during infancy. items.summary: A supermassive black hole has been found lurking about 30,000 light-years from the center of its galaxy—the first dormant black hole detected so far from a galactic core. It revealed itself only after shredding a passing star and producing a brief, brilliant flare. Astronomers think it may be the re

items.summary: Genetic changes may set off a chain reaction that causes the spine’s natural shock absorbers to harden and deteriorate. Zebrafish with a faulty collagen-related gene developed mineral buildup and spinal fusion similar to human disc disease. Researchers were able to reduce the damage using an existin

items.title: Engineers build world's first portable diamond-powered quantum computer — it works at room temperature and can be plugged into an outlet
items.summary: The world's first portable, room-temperature quantum computer with more than 10 qubits utilizes flawed lab-made diamonds. The quantum system fits into a standard server rack and connects to a typical power grid.
items.zh: 工程师打造出世界上第一台便携式金刚石供电量子计算机——它在室温下工作并且可以插入插座

items.summary: Millions of sperm do not always compete alone—some species send them into action as coordinated teams. items.zh: 忘记精子竞赛：受精可能取决于团队合作

items.summary: Ancient seafloor sediments have revealed a surprising twist in how the Atlantic’s massive circulation system works.
